projects.title: BSc Thesis: AR Escape Room
projects.description:
BSc thesis project developed at the University of Piraeus.

AR Escape Room is an augmented reality puzzle game built with Unity and Vuforia. The application recognizes printed markers through the device camera, allowing players to explore rooms, search for hidden objects, and solve escape-room-inspired puzzles.

The project uses an AR paper marker as the playable scene and an AR cube as the selected inventory item. Players can inspect the cube by rotating it in their hands or use it to place objects into the scene and solve puzzles.

projects.title: MSc Thesis: Mixed Reality interactive experience using HoloLens 2
projects.description:
MSc thesis project developed at Abertay University.

This mixed reality HoloLens 2 experience uses Unity to scan and understand the real-world room, then spawns interactive cockroaches across floors and walls. Players can interact with them using hand tracking and eye-based input.

The cockroaches can navigate across detected surfaces, follow the player, produce 3D positional audio, transition between planes, and move from the environment onto the user's hand.

projects.title: Lost In Dimension
projects.description:
Group submission for the Online Together Jam.

Lost In Dimension is an asymmetric cooperative multiplayer puzzle game where two players experience the same world from different perspectives. One player controls a girl exploring the room directly, while the other controls a ghost boy through a text-adventure-style interface.

Each player has access to different information, so communication is required to solve puzzles and progress. I developed the top-down gameplay section, networking, and parts of the UI, while another programmer worked on the text-based gameplay.

projects.title: MSc Project: AI Rocket Genetic Algorithms
projects.description:
MSc project exploring genetic algorithms through a Unity simulation.

The project trains rockets to navigate an obstacle course by evolving movement behaviour over successive generations. It demonstrates how genetic algorithms can be applied to real-time decision-making, path optimisation, and game-style physics challenges.

Built in Unity and C# as a practical machine learning and simulation exercise.

projects.title: MSc Project: Reinforcement Q-Learning Rocket
projects.description:
MSc project exploring reinforcement learning through a Unity simulation.

The project uses Q-Learning to train a rocket to navigate through obstacles. Through repeated attempts, the rocket learns to improve its path and adapt its movement decisions based on rewards and penalties.

Built in Unity and C# as a hands-on experiment in reinforcement learning, real-time navigation, and game-based AI simulation.

projects.title: MSc Project: Bomberman Multiplayer
projects.description:
MSc project focused on real-time online multiplayer gameplay.

Bomberman Multiplayer is a top-down arena game for up to four players, built in Unity and C#. Players move through a maze, place timed bombs, collect coins, and compete to survive or reach the score limit first.

The project uses .NET sockets for real-time network communication and was developed as a practical exploration of multiplayer architecture, synchronization, and gameplay rules.

projects.title: MSc Project: DirectX Playable Scene
projects.description:
MSc project built in C++ using DirectX and HLSL.

This project is a playable 3D scene created to explore lower-level rendering, shader programming, input handling, and real-time graphics fundamentals outside of a commercial game engine.

projects.title: MSc Project: DirectX Procedural Generation
projects.description:
MSc project built in C++ using DirectX and HLSL.

This prototype explores procedural generation and rendering techniques in a custom DirectX scene. The project includes configurable generation settings, visual results, post-processing work, and a small interactive minigame.

projects.description:

The Entertainment Quiz is a quiz game with single-player and local multiplayer modes, inspired by board game formats such as Trivial Pursuit. The game includes multiple categories, a leaderboard, and a local party-game structure.

The project reached 10K+ downloads on the Microsoft Store.
